series_description: Tico es una ardilla curiosa que vive en el Bosque Mágico. En cada episodio aprende valiosas lecciones sobre amistad, honestidad, valentía y otros valores importantes mientras explora su mundo y ayuda a sus amigos del bosque.

consistency.art_style: 3D Disney/Pixar style, magical forest setting with vibrant colors, warm cinematic lighting, detailed character expressions

characters.name: Tico
characters.visual_description: Friendly squirrel with bright orange fur, big expressive eyes, wearing a small green adventurer's backpack with acorns and a tiny compass
characters.personality: curious, brave, sometimes impulsive but always learns from mistakes, loves helping friends

characters.name: Narrator
characters.personality: warm, encouraging, asks questions to engage viewers, patient and supportive
